description: Medical device adverse events (FDA MAUDE) — Has this medical device been reported for malfunctions, injuries or deaths? Searches FDA MAUDE adverse event reports by device brand or generic name, 3-letter product code or manufacturer (optionally since a date) and returns the total report count, counts by event type (death, injury, malfunction), the most reported product problems, and the newest reports with dates, model, problems and a short event narrative. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).

device.description: brand or generic name, e.g. insulin pump

product_code.description: or a 3-letter FDA product code, e.g. LZG

name: fda_device_events
